main.description: Count active (completed) tips. If recordUri is provided, counts tips for that record. If subject is provided, counts tips received by that DID. If neither is provided, counts tips sent by the authenticated user. Optionally filtered by a start/end datetime window. When the authenticated user is the subject/owner of the target, the response also includes the sum of amounts.

recordUri.description: AT-URI of the record being tipped. Takes precedence over subject.

subject.description: DID of the tip recipient. Ignored if recordUri is provided. If omitted (and recordUri is omitted), the query counts tips sent by the authenticated user.

startDate.description: Only count tips completed at or after this timestamp

endDate.description: Only count tips completed at or before this timestamp

count.description: Number of active (completed) tips matching the filter

amount.description: Sum of all tip amounts in cents. Only returned when the authenticated user is the subject/owner of the target (or when counting their own sent tips).

currency.description: Currency of the summed amount. Only returned when the authenticated user is the subject/owner of the target (or when counting their own sent tips).
